description: Cumulative CPU-only verification through Claim 6. Rerun Claims 1-5, including the self-contained circles small/large-beta verifier, then execute the authors' saved 3e-3 SOSMC-ULA sweep on the official checkpointed convolutional MNIST EBM across the exact three-reward by four-beta grid. Evaluate terminal fresh reward with three paired seeds under the distinct original pretraining sampler. Use a separately validated recognizer only as a semantic diagnostic; decide anti-hacking acceptance with classifier-independent pixel morphology calibrated from held-out real MNIST and pretrained EBM samples.
